cli.help:
lipi — manage project documentation, workflow documents, and trace markers.

    lipi guide                read the setup guide before initializing a project
    lipi init [directory] [--type app] [--docs …] [--workflow …]
              [--enforce] [--ci github] [--dry-run]
                              apply the installed rules, create missing starter files
                              on first setup, and align the hook with enforce
    lipi ci github [directory]  install the managed GitHub Actions workflow
    lipi migrate [directory] [--apply]  plan or apply a workflow migration
    lipi mv old new [--apply]
    lipi mv --from file [--apply]  plan or apply a move and update references
    lipi check                run fast checks; errors give a nonzero exit code
         --staged             check staged changes for documentation drift
         --diff A...B         check changes in a Git revision range
         --strict             treat warnings as errors
         --no-baseline        show all errors, including those in the baseline
    lipi baseline [--prune]   record existing errors or remove resolved entries
    lipi audit                run checks and report findings requiring judgment
         --reviews-since REV  list new review marks by author since a revision
    lipi slice target         inspect a target; --diff base or --staged for changes
                              --format json, --full, --depth 2|3, --layer, --only
    lipi review target --at path[:line]
                              preview an A4 pair; --confirm TOKEN --by author --reason text
    lipi review --prune       preview removal of obsolete marks; --confirm TOKEN to apply
    lipi map [--format json]  show trace coverage by target, code layer, and tests
    lipi doctor [directory]   diagnose setup, versions, lock, hook, index, and baseline
    lipi index                rebuild the workflow index
    lipi new type "Title" [kind] [lipi]  create a pln, iss, dsc, adr, or aud document
    lipi collect directory [...]  collect issues addressed to lipi
                              (from a lipi clone or an editable install)
    lipi lang [language]      show or choose your interface language
    lipi selftest             run lipi’s own tests
    lipi version [--path]     print the installed version and optionally the checker path
    lipi help                 show this help; also shown when run without arguments

collect.usage:
Usage, from a clone of the lipi repository, which receives the copies:
    python3 src/lipi/collect.py <project> [<project> ...]
With an editable install (pipx install --editable .) from that clone:
    lipi collect <project> [<project> ...]
A regular installation has no lipi repository to write into.

Collect issues addressed to lipi. Create one with:
    lipi new iss "What got in the way" friction lipi

The issue has a `Recipient: lipi` field and lives in the project's
workflow/issue/ directory or in .agents/lipi-feedback/ if workflow documents
are disabled. The command copies it to lipi's workflow/issue/YYYY/ with the
next number and a Source field of the form `external <hash> ISS-NNN`, where
the hash is the first six characters of the SHA-256 of the project directory
name in UTF-8. Repeat runs skip issues already collected.

Remove identifying information from the issue's title and body before
collecting. The original issue stays in the project.
